name: Midoriya Tatsuki
source:
A dragon and a gentle giant. He does have wings, but they're too small for flight. His father is a master carpenter; as a result, he wants to be one, too, someday. He's known to be accident prone, and him driving a car leads to disastrous results. Tatsuki gets really horny when he drinks a lot of sake.

[From [url=http://en.wikifur.com/wiki/Morenatsu]Wikifur[/url]]
